notes.title: New Constellation and Multiplayer Maps!
notes.content:
Today we have released a brand new constellation with 11 levels and 3 new multiplayer maps. The new constellation is called FRACTURE becuase of its new unique gameplay where planets get destroyed and become useless. If you wait long enough though, the planets heal themselves and become available again. 

Also in this update:
* Re-worked multiplayer functionality improves lag and player experience
across the board.
* Thousands of units now maneuver around planets and obstacles.
* More stars and planetary art in the background.

Enjoy! And as always, let us know what you think.

notes.title: Auralux: Constellations is now available on iOS & Android devices!
notes.content:
Have you ever had the need to play Auralux: Constellations when you aren't in front of your PC? Now you can play on the go with the mobile version!


iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/auralux-constellations/id1119322616?ls=1&mt=8

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wardrumstudios.auralux2


Stay tuned for more updates on the PC version of Auralux: Constellations!

notes.title: Save and Resume
notes.content:
It's here! You can easily save and resume your single player games now. Try  it out by simply exiting your single player game and you'll be given the option of saving it for later.

Resume your game from the main menu whenever you have a chance to get back to Auralux! :-)

notes.title: New Major Update
notes.content:
Features and improvements:

* New! Join in progress support means you can join a friend's multiplayer game at any time
* New! A public match server browser allows you to see all multiplayer games in progress
* New! Game has been optimized and now supports up to 10,000 unique units in single player
* Better Steam multiplayer integration and friend joining (fixed several issues)
* Improvements and bug fixes in UI, including the flickering mouse some people were getting

notes.title: Changes in latest update. Includes several requested options!
notes.content:
Auralux: Constellations v1.01

- Free look inside of the constellations selection! Hold your mouse button and look around. :-)
- Added option to remove hints when starting a level you haven't beaten
- Added option to remove initial level zoom
- Added option to specify whether game should auto pause when the game loses focus
- Added option to display the current level time in single player levels for players trying to beat records
- Added zoom button to game stats that allows you to view a larger version of the graph
- Some from the classic levels were tweaked to behave like the original game
- Fixes:
 * Various improvements to gamepad controls
 * The chat and mouse now work correctly in tandem
 * Player win %'s no longer misattribute in multiplayer in the end game graph
 * Level hint now appears in center of screen to make it more apparent (you can still disable with the new option)
 * Orbiting sun pulses now follow their sun properly
